links.outcome: Accuracy on clinical calculator cases (1,100 cases, 55 calculators)
links.effect: 7B: 75.31% vs 72.02%, paired +3.29 points, 95% calculator-cluster CI [-3.49, 10.38] (not a reliable advantage); 32B: 90.53% vs 83.47%, +7.05 [0.47, 14.60], clear of zero
